from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from pathlib import Path
with TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    target = Path(directory) / '.env'
    target.write_text('VFARL_LOCAL_ENV_VALUE=present\n')
    env = Env()
    result = env.read_env(target, return_path=True)
    print(result)
    assert result == str(target)
    assert env('VFARL_LOCAL_ENV_VALUE') == 'present'
